title: urophyllum clemensiorum

It is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used in Southeast Asia to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, and are used to treat conditions like fever, pain, and infections.
